first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Walking in front, wearing a slightly tilted gray-green round-crowned steel helmet with a wide brim, with a brown sleeveless outer layer over an olive uniform and a diagonal strap; gradually moves to the image-right side and turns their head.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: Following Person A, with a relatively long, thin face and wearing a dark gray-green round-crowned steel helmet with a wide brim; in the later portion, a high-collared uniform, brown sleeveless outer layer, and light brown strap are visible.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: Reinforced walls on both sides of the passageway, composed of brown earthen walls, wooden planks, and vertical posts, excluding the ground, sky, and objects atop the walls.

entities.name: trench cable
entities.identification: Multiple thin lines extending along the left wall and wooden posts, locally gathered and curving downward, recorded collectively by area.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: The set of long guns visible behind the shoulders and backs of Person A and Person B, distinguished by their count and corresponding positions relative to the persons.
